steps.content: While Yao explains why the bird refuses to return, a solution has already formed in your mind. She appears to be arriving at the same conclusion.
Yet neither of you embraces it willingly, because—

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: So, a tale must be woven—a little stage upon which this fledgling's wish may be fulfilled—and only then will it consent to return to Yao. Have I grasped the thread correctly?

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: And should this tale remain untold, our tiny friend here shall continue to swell with the hopes and longings of all who cross its path. Perhaps, in time... a second Sun Crow would rise?

steps.speaker: Yao
steps.content: You see it clearly, Miss Yugu.
You catch the amused expression on Yugu's face while she observes Yao, and quickly jump in.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: It doesn't need to be anything fancy. Just a basic setup. Honestly, even an empty room would do the job.
Yugu smiles, drawing a story book from the depths of her wide sleeves, and leafs through its pages with care.

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: A part of me confesses... I should dearly love to witness the birth of a second Sun Crow...
A blank page opens before you. The shackles tremble softly, and Yugu lets her power flow free.

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: ...yet this, too, makes for an enchanting prologue.
Yugu watches, and your forms melt away. Reality dissolves before your eyes as a force seizes you, dragging you down in a dizzying plunge.
Her voice ripples through the void, amused.

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: For you, Chief, and Yao, I shall exercise restraint, a courtesy born of kinship and respect. The ink of this tale shall flow untainted by my influence.

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: That said, a storyteller worth her salt would never suffer her audience to endure a barren narrative...

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: So then. Revel in the story as it unfolds... and do try to enjoy the reflections of your own heart along the way.
The world whirls around you. You feel your body and mind slipping into a heavy darkness. A stretch of time passes, then you touch down softly, and light floods back into the world before your eyes.
(Sound of bustling traffic)

A small town spreads out before you. The streets swim with the warm scent of fresh pastries and drifting steam; red paper couplets still hold the faint tang of ink. It is a bustling, cheerful scene. But beyond the distant mountains, dark clouds gather and threaten.
You scan your surroundings, yet the "little birds" who entered this "story" alongside you are nowhere to be seen.

steps.speaker: Vendor
steps.content: Hey there, friend! Friend! Care for a wishing rope?
A vendor's shout cuts through your thoughts. He extends a colorful rope toward you, his face split with a bright grin.

steps.speaker: Vendor
steps.content: Been watching you look around for a good while now. You're not buying any festival goods, not trading for anything new... so I got to thinking, maybe you're here for one of these, eh?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: A wishing rope...? Is there some kind of deity people worship around here?

steps.speaker: Vendor
steps.content: Oh-ho! Not from these parts, are ya? Well then, you've come to the right fella!
The vendor pushes the pretty rope into your palms, tugs you forward, and gestures toward a spot just ahead, already launching into a lively explanation.

steps.speaker: Vendor
steps.content: We pay our respects to the Sun Crow Goddess! She's got herself a shawl of woven clouds and carries a lantern right from the heavens. Keeps all sorts of calamity away from us! Everyone in these parts, we're all still standing thanks to Her protection!

steps.speaker: Vendor
steps.content: Now, the Goddess herself ain't shown her face in nearly a hundred years. But folks around here, we say when the year's wrapping up, she still slips on down to the mortal world, gathers up what's in folks' hearts, and then...

The vendor's chatter dies mid-sentence, his eyes going wide as he gazes into the distance. You track his stare, and your breath catches. A massive orb flickers with orange light, hurtling toward the earth ahead at terrifying speed.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Wait, is that...?
Boom!!
The lively street goes utterly still. The orb slams into the ground, and nothing remains but thick, rolling clouds of dust.
Before a single soul can respond, a sharp cry pierces through the haze.

steps.speaker: Child
steps.content: It's... It's the Sun Crow Goddess! She really came! The Sun Crow Goddess... she finally came back to see us!
Just off the main street, an open area teems with people gathered in tight rings, lifting their colored rope knots high as they shout out their wishes.
You fight with all your strength to shoulder through the pressing crowd.
Sure enough, standing at the center of the crowd is Yao.
Only now she wears a flowing gauze gown, nearly identical to the Sun Crow Goddess the vendor spoke of, draped in a cloud-patterned ceremonial shawl, a sky lantern held in her hands.

steps.speaker: Fledgling
steps.content: Chirp!
Your sight cuts to black as something warm and fluffy smacks against your face. It's a familiar, feathery weight. In that sudden dark, a hand seizes yours.
You pluck the fluffy ball from your face with practiced ease, then gently let your shackles' power flow free, soothing both the agitated little bird and Yao, whose grip on your hand remains tight.
The crowd sees Yao draw you close, and for one held breath, they go still before bursting into wild cheers.

steps.speaker: Crowd
steps.content: It's the envoy! The Goddess has chosen her envoy!

steps.speaker: Crowd
steps.content: Goddess! Envoy! Please, hear our prayers! Hear our wishes!

steps.speaker: Yao
steps.content: Please... Everyone, please slow down... If you keep pushing forward like this, someone will get hurt...
The crowd presses inward, ring upon ring. The little bird on your shoulder stirs with growing unease beneath the weight of their prayers, shifting anxiously as its round body swells ever larger.
A dull ache throbs through your shackles. Something unseen is gathering strength.
Though you understand this is nothing more than one of Yugu's tales, you find no will to interrupt. They are merely offering their prayers.
Silence, all of you! How dare you act so shamelessly before the Goddess herself!
The Sun Crow Tower isn't even finished, and you lot think you've earned the right to make wishes of Her?!

Just as the tension nears its breaking point, an old man with a silver beard pushes through the crowd on your behalf, granting you a brief reprieve. Once the others draw back, he turns toward you and slowly drops to his knees.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Whoa, no, no, no! Sir, please, you really don't have to do that!
You and Yao rush forward, attempting to lift the elder back to his feet, yet despite your every protest, he remains firmly on his knees and will not rise.

steps.speaker: Old Man
steps.content: We've waited... we've waited almost a hundred years... Sun Crow Goddess... You've finally... You've truly returned to us. In the flesh...!
A low roll of thunder rumbles from afar. One by one, the people who press close just moments before follow the elder's lead, sinking to their knees in reverence.

steps.speaker: Old Man
steps.content: The Goddess Tower is already near halfway built! We'll work faster, we swear it! Just... please, I beg of you... watch over us!

steps.speaker: Crowd
steps.content: Please watch over us!
Past the folded mountain ridges, an endless bank of storm clouds creeps nearer. The dark crimson lightning flickering within grows sharper by the moment, an ominous vision.
You and Yao trade a glance, instantly understanding. The goddess who once shielded these towns from ruin has long since vanished from sight.
The calamity that still rages has likely twisted the wards she left behind. Now the towns teeter on the edge of annihilation...
And so the people raise the Goddess Tower, praying that it might summon her back in time to usher in the New Year in safety.

steps.speaker: Fledgling
steps.content: Cheep! Cheeeeep!!

The little bird on your shoulder latches onto your collar with its beak and tumbles to the ground, then bounces over to the waiting crowd. It snatches a wish ribbon from a young child's grasp and flits back in your direction.

But the ribbon is far too long. Before the bird can hop more than a pace or two, the fabric snarls around its round belly. Bird and ribbon go tumbling end over end, landing in a clumsy heap at Yao's feet.
Yao scoops up the little bird and works the ribbon free, only then catching sight of the shaky, childish script etched upon it. It's a wish, tiny and sincere.
I hope Mom finishes the Goddess Tower quick, so she can come home and eat with us. I hope Dad stays safe, and comes back home safe from the faraway mountains.

steps.speaker: Yao
steps.content: Everyone... please, rise.

Yao lets go of your hand and cradles the little bird in her palms, raising it before her with quiet solemnity. The shackles that bind you together grow still, and in that calm, you understand exactly what she means to do.

steps.speaker: Yao
steps.content: I have heard all of you.

steps.speaker: Yao
steps.content: Since I have returned, and since your hearts have spoken true, I shall watch over this land.

steps.speaker: Yao
steps.content: But... there is no need to raise stones in my name. No need for towers.

steps.speaker: Yao
steps.content: The year is ending. What I long to see... is each of you safe and warm. Home with the ones you love, in good health and good spirits.

steps.speaker: Old Man
steps.content: But the tower is already half standing! If we just leave it be, how could we ever be worthy of Your blessing?
The elder shakes his head, and the surrounding crowd voices their agreement, insisting that the tower must be completed.

steps.speaker: Yao
steps.content: This... this is enough.
Yao slips the wish ribbon free from the elder's wrist. The little bird brushes softly against his skin, leaving a gentle, soothing warmth in its wake.

steps.speaker: Yao
steps.content: Leave your ribbons with me. That is all I ask.

steps.speaker: Old Man
steps.content: But... but surely...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Sir. Please.
You step up and dip into a respectful bow before the elder.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: The Goddess has given her word. You can all go home now, really.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: If you still want to do something for her... then figure out how to make this new year a happy one. That's what she wants.
Night settles over the land, but the clouds pressing against the far peaks do not melt into shadow. They pulse with a red that grows ever more vivid, ever more threatening.
Together, you and Yao stand at the foot of the unfinished tower, your gazes fixed on the distant horizon, your expressions heavy with unspoken weight.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: So... the big crisis in this story looks like some kind of calamity. You got any ideas?

steps.speaker: Yao
steps.content: It spans far and wide... I could address it directly, but the root of it lies much higher. If we wish to truly resolve this...
At these words, the two of you turn in unison, gazing back at the half-finished tower that rises behind you.

steps.speaker: Yao
steps.content: It seems we'll need to see this tower completed, together.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Wait, I have to help build it too?

steps.speaker: Yao
steps.content: Well... this place is a story, after all, woven from Miss Yugu's gift. And since she is a Sinner bound by your shackles...

steps.speaker: Yao
steps.content: Perhaps you might reach through that bond and influence the shape of things.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Yeah... that makes sense...
You follow Yao back inside the tower. There, the little bird lies nestled among a heap of bright wish ribbons, sound asleep.
No longer does it swell round and plump from the prayers and faith it absorbs; instead, it grows slender and elegant, poised as though it might unfurl its wings and leap into the air at any second.
Yao brushes her fingers across the ribbons, touching them as if they were something precious and breakable.

steps.speaker: Yao
steps.content: Tomorrow... let us grant their wishes.
